title: More creative projects in the directory
summary:
Community projects filled out the directory while text request queues and model selection got a tune-up.

The Creative projects directory gained listings for Chinese-language image and audio generation, cat comics, multilingual image prompts, and other image-making tools. Separate edits rearranged the directory and removed two listings, so the additions do not all represent the final lineup.

A Mita joined the games directory with AI conversations in Roblox. AI drafterplus was added to the chat directory in two PRs, and GPT_Project’s listing was corrected and moved to Social Bots.

Text-service queue settings now allow up to three token-authenticated requests per one-second interval and pace requests with a referrer at one per three-second interval. Roblox and gacha11211 referrers also no longer force the llamascout model.
